不同寻常的灵脉（不同寻常的灵脉（第22页）不过在经历了刚才的事情后，韩林对这上面的任务已经没了兴趣。他将任务清单随手收起，又拿起桌上的储物袋检查起来。这是一个下品储物袋，里面空间极小，装着一千颗中品灵石以及一块叶家记名客卿的身份令牌。“这叶家倒还挺大方的，竟然给一千中品灵石的见面礼。”韩林轻笑一声，将灵石转移到通天宝库。此时，通天宝库内的中品灵石数量，已经达到十五万七千之多。距离他所需的五十万，又近了一步。至于下品灵石，那更是堆积如山，还有一千三百多万！以前被他视若珍宝的东西，现在看起来就好像垃圾一样，堆在那里用不上也不舍得丢。接下来的几天，韩林在通天法界的帮助下，全身心投入到了灵符制作之中。刚开始的时候，成功率只有百分之十左右！但随着他越画越顺手，成功率也逐渐地攀升了起来，最终定格在百分之五十。这个成功率，若是让周谌知道了，怕是会从地府冒出来问问韩林，到底是不是人。因为当初，他用同样的锁灵纹，成功率最高也就百分之十而已。不过到了五十的成功率，韩林也无法再提升上去了。不是精血品质不够高，也不是韩林制符过程不完美，而是这玄葫锁灵纹的极限似乎就在这里。想要继续提升，除非得到更高级的锁灵纹才行。在通天法界辅助下，韩林仅用三天时间就将当初在卧龙禁地内猎杀到的三阶兽血，以及从周谌身上得到的三阶兽血，全部消耗一空。最终成功刻画出六百张逍遥符！即便按照五十中品灵石一张，也足够将购买符笔和符纸的成本全部收回来了。韩林将制符工具收起，来到院子里面休息了一下。忽然想到，这一走不知什么时候才回来，于是就打开西屋的房门走了进去。或许是空间完全密闭，灵气跑不出去的缘故，韩林刚一进门，就感觉身体一阵毛孔舒张，舒服极了。随后，韩林就在房间中央位置盘膝坐下，开始修炼了起来。随着他运转《金龟朝元心经》，身体表面泛起淡淡黄光，周围的灵气立刻朝他汹涌而来！随后在丹田中快速凝练成真元之力，最后继续精炼成丹元，融入九色金丹之中。虽然不如中品灵石效果那么好，但确实是有效果的。“咦？不对劲。”忽然，韩林发现一个令他震惊的事情。按道理来说，以他的吸收速度，这房间里面的灵气应该很快就会被吸收干净，然后等重新恢复才是。可情况却是，他已经修炼了足足一刻钟，房间里面的灵气除了略微稀薄之外，却压根没有断层的意思。这足以说明，这山中的灵脉强度，超出了他的预料。“待我看上一看。”韩林当即走出房间，纵身一跃，就来到了竹海的半空之上。接着伸出右手，掌心向下，激活洞察入微天赋，对着这座山峰仔细检查起来。

Chapter 487 Unusual spiritual veins (page 1)
Unusual Spiritual Veins (Unusual Spiritual Veins (Page 22)) However, after what happened just now, Han Lin was no longer interested in this task. He put away the task list and picked up the storage bag on the table to check it out. It was a low-grade storage bag with very little space inside, containing a thousand middle-grade spiritual stones and an identity token of the Ye family’s guest minister. “The Ye family is quite generous, actually. Then I gave him a gift of one thousand middle-grade spirit stones." Han Lin chuckled and transferred the spirit stones to the Tongtian Treasure House. At this time, the number of medium-grade spirit stones in the Tongtian Treasure House had reached 157,000. It was one step closer to the half a million he needed. As for the low-grade spirit stones, they were piled up like mountains, with more than 13 million left! The things he once regarded as treasures now looked like garbage, piled there for use. In the next few days, with the help of Tongtian Dharma Realm, Han Lin devoted himself to making the talisman. At the beginning, the success rate was only about 10%, but as he became more and more comfortable, the success rate gradually increased, and finally settled at 50%. If Zhou Chen knew about it, he would probably come out of the underworld to ask Han Lin if he was human. . Because at the beginning, when he used the same spirit-locking pattern, the success rate was only 10%. However, when the success rate reached 50, it was not that the quality of the blood essence was not high enough, or that Han Lin's process of making the talisman was not perfect, but the limit of the mysterious gourd-locking pattern seemed to be here. With the help of Tongtian Dharma Realm, Han Lin only needed three days. In a short period of time, he consumed all the third-level beast blood he had hunted in the Wolong Forbidden Land and the third-level beast blood he obtained from Zhou Chen. He finally succeeded in carving out 600 free talismans! Even if it were a fifty-medium grade spiritual stone, it was enough to recoup the cost of purchasing the talisman pen and talisman paper. Han Lin put away the talisman-making tools and came to the yard to take a rest. , so he opened the door of the west room and walked in. Perhaps it was because the space was completely sealed and the spiritual energy could not escape. As soon as he entered the door, Han Lin felt his body relax and feel very comfortable. Then, Han Lin sat down cross-legged in the center of the room and began to practice. As he ran the "Golden Turtle Chaoyuan Heart Sutra", a faint yellow light appeared on the surface of his body, and the surrounding spiritual energy surged toward him! He quickly condensed it into true energy, and finally continued to refine it into the nine-color golden elixir. Although it was not as effective as the middle-grade spiritual stone, it was indeed effective. "Huh? Something is wrong." Suddenly, Han Lin discovered something that shocked him. Logically speaking, with his absorption speed, the spiritual energy in this room should be absorbed quickly, and then it would be restored. But the situation was that he After practicing for a full quarter of an hour, the spiritual energy in the room was slightly thin, but there was no sign of any disconnection at all. This was enough to show that the strength of the spiritual veins in the mountain exceeded his expectations. "Let me take a closer look." Han Lin immediately walked out of the room, jumped up, and reached the mid-air of the bamboo sea. Then he stretched out his right hand, palm down, and activated his talent for insight into the mountain.
